s1.syndrome_frame: Acute to subacute onset of painful, itchy, and bleeding skin lesions with a mixture of pustules and plaques, primarily affecting the face, scalp, trunk, and extremities, with a significant impact on mobility
salient_findings: Pustules and hemorrhagic-crusted plaques on the scalp, legs, arms, and trunk
Difficulty walking due to skin lesions
Epidermal hyperplasia and exocytosis of neutrophils on histopathology
Dense dermal-mixed inflammatory cell infiltration with microabscesses
key_facts: Teenaged male patient
2-week history of skin lesions
Lesions began as pustules and developed into painful, itchy plaques
Prior treatment with prednisolone, clindamycin hydrochloride, and fluconazole
Continued development of new lesions despite treatment
Difficulty walking due to skin lesions
Pustules and hemorrhagic-crusted plaques on the scalp, legs, arms, and trunk
Keloidal plaques on the face
Negative HIV test result
Histopathology showing epidermal hyperplasia, exocytosis of neutrophils, and dense dermal-mixed inflammatory cell infiltration
Microabscesses scattered with eosinophils on histopathology
No granulomas or multinucleated giant cells on histopathology
Negative periodic acid-Schiff staining

shortlist.label: Pyoderma gangrenosum
shortlist.why_kept: Painful, itchy, and bleeding skin lesions with a mixture of pustules and plaques, consistent with the patient's presentation

shortlist.label: Sweet syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Acute onset of painful, itchy, and bleeding skin lesions, with histopathology showing dense dermal-mixed inflammatory cell infiltration and microabscesses

shortlist.label: Erythema elevatum diutinum
shortlist.why_kept: Pustules and hemorrhagic-crusted plaques on the scalp, legs, arms, and trunk, with a significant impact on mobility

shortlist.label: Generalized pustular psoriasis
shortlist.why_kept: Pustules and ulcerated plaques, with a history of continued development of new lesions despite treatment

shortlist.label: Acute febrile neutrophilic dermatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Acute onset of painful, itchy, and bleeding skin lesions, with histopathology showing epidermal hyperplasia, exocytosis of neutrophils, and dense dermal-mixed inflammatory cell infiltration

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of painful, itchy plaques that began as pustules, along with histopathology showing epidermal hyperplasia, exocytosis of neutrophils, and dense dermal-mixed inflammatory cell infiltration, is consistent with Sweet syndrome. The presence of microabscesses scattered with eosinophils and the lack of granulomas or multinucleated giant cells also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Pyoderma gangrenosum
rejected.why: While pyoderma gangrenosum can present with painful ulcers, the histopathology typically shows a more pronounced neutrophilic infiltrate and the presence of granulomas, which are not seen in this case.

rejected.label: Erythema elevatum diutinum
rejected.why: Erythema elevatum diutinum is characterized by chronic, symmetric, and palpable purpura, which is not consistent with the patient's presentation of acute, painful plaques.

rejected.label: Generalized pustular psoriasis
rejected.why: Generalized pustular psoriasis typically presents with widespread pustules on an erythematous base, and the histopathology shows a more pronounced epidermal hyperplasia and parakeratosis, which is not seen in this case.

rejected.label: Acute febrile neutrophilic dermatosis
rejected.why: Acute febrile neutrophilic dermatosis is a condition that presents with fever, neutrophilia, and a characteristic dermatosis, but the patient's presentation and histopathology are more consistent with Sweet syndrome.
